name: Log Size / Largest Strongly Shattered Set
details: For every finite binary class, log size is at least the largest strongly shattered-set size.
proof: A strongly shattered set of size $d$ is the free-coordinate set of a contained $d$-cube. Its $2^d$ cube vertices are distinct members of $\mathcal H$, so $|\mathcal H|\geq2^d$ and $\log_2|\mathcal H|\geq d$.
